channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: ‘Model fatigue’ sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions at frenetic pace
item.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Google all released model updates this week, while Nvidia said it's acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face.

item.title: Iran warns of ‘more painful’ response to U.S. attacks as economic pressure mounts
item.description: Iran warned of faster, heavier retaliation against U.S. attacks while acknowledging the war’s mounting toll on its economy.

item.title: Trump turns up the heat on Warsh as Fed rate hike looms
item.description: Ten days ahead of the next Federal Reserve meeting, the Trump administration looks to be in a full-court press to halt a rate hike in its tracks.

item.title: This enhanced geothermal project aims to unlock gigawatts of power to fuel the data center boom
item.description: Power demand in the U.S. is rising. Fervo Energy bets that its project in Utah will prove that enhanced geothermal can be part of the power mix going forward.

item.title: Trump’s state capitalism comes to the oil industry with his unprecedented Venezuela deal
item.description: The deal comes eight months after Washington ousted former President Nicolás Maduro in a military raid.

item.title: Goldman Sachs says buy the dip in these five stocks before it's too late
item.description: The Wall Street investment bank said this week investors should take advantage of recent declines in several stocks.

item.title: LeBron James teases partnership with Polymarket
item.description: LeBron James on Saturday teased an upcoming partnership with the prediction markets platform Polymarket in a social media post.

item.title: AI data centers are transforming rural land markets — and fueling a backlash
item.description: The data center buildout is driving up the price of rural land as some farmers and property owners buy in and others push back against development.

item.title: Kremlin says Ukraine talks with U.S. envoys were useful; no sign of breakthrough
item.description: Putin reportedly said Russia was making "real progress" on the battlefield, while voicing the need to address "all the root causes of the conflict."

item.title: Women accounted for almost all of job gains in August. Here's why
item.description: Women accounted for virtually all of August's payroll gains, the latest sign of their growing power in the labor market.

item.title: With HSAs, employers are turning to the 401(k) playbook
item.description: More employers are automatically enrolling workers into health savings accounts and paying contributions like a "match."

item.title: Trump admin targets tax-exempt status at private colleges — threatening a key tax break for donations
item.description: The Treasury has proposed regulations that would strip thousands of private schools of their tax-exempt status and threaten a valuable tax break for donations.

item.title: Many truckers don't feel like the rest of America about AI data centers as business booms
item.description: Sprawling data center components from HVAC systems to tubing, wiring and semiconductors arrive primarily by truck, a boon for a business hit hard by trade wars.

item.title: GM vs. Ford: U.S. defense, energy sectors add to automakers' century-old rivalry
item.description: General Motors and Ford are looking for new potential growth areas, including by seeking military contracts and getting into energy storage businesses.

item.title: Why Walmart is moving in on DoorDash, Uber Eats delivery action, starting with donuts, coffee and sandwiches
item.description: Walmart's deal to deliver for Dunkin' follows one earlier this year for Subway sandwiches, as the nation's largest retailer targets Uber Eats and DoorDash.

item.title: Trump’s first major midterm money move: A $10 million Texas Senate ad blitz
item.description: MAGA, Inc., has at least $400 million in campaign funds that GOP candidates have been waiting for the president to deploy.

item.title: Abel: Two ways Berkshire hopes to cash in on AI
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel tells CNBC the company is pursuing AI opportunities on two paths.

item.title: From ‘mystery vacations’ to hostels, budget travelers get thrifty as prices rise
item.description: Despite rising prices and the travel industry focusing on the luxury segment, budget-minded vacationers are still finding ways to get away.

item.title: Longtime Fox News host Maria Bartiromo disputes reports of termination
item.description: Maria Bartiromo, the longtime host of Fox News and Fox Business programming, has disputed reports she was fired from the cable TV networks.

item.title: Icons Dolly Parton and Gloria Steinem never officially retired—why that's a choice for some and requirement for others
item.description: The idea of never retiring sounds awful to some, but inspiring to others who want to pursue their passions long after they've left full-time work.

item.title: Americans hit with record-high Labor Day Weekend gasoline prices
item.description: The national average gasoline price will probably hit $4.03 on Labor Day, topping the record $3.83 per gallon set in 2012, said GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan.

item.title: Student loan repayment plans: What are your options now?
item.description: If you're one of the 7.7 million Americans who need to switch from the SAVE plan, here are a variety of options.

item.title: I'm a nutritionist from Japan: 7 'essential' anti-inflammatory foods that I swear by
item.description: Japanese nutritionist and longevity expert Michiko Tomioka shares the inflammation-fighting foods that are always in her kitchen.

item.title: White House has vetted candidates for key CFTC vacancies, sources tell CNBC. It's unclear if they will be filled
item.description: Filling open commissioner positions at the regulatory agency has been a sticking point in negotiations over the Clarity Act.

item.title: Anthropic IPO launch shifts toward mid-October: Reuters
item.description: The artificial intelligence company had been expected to make its IPO prospectus public as early as next week, two sources told Reuters.

item.title: THC drinks could soon be harder to find as Congress delays hemp ban again
item.description: THC drinks are booming as an alcohol alternative, but a looming federal crackdown is squeezing makers, distributors and consumers.

item.title: The big business of personal protection: How private security became a $50 billion industry
item.description: Private security spending and guard employment have climbed as companies and communities respond to high-profile attacks, even as violent crime falls.

item.title: Tesla's stock drops 6% as Cybercab update 'underwhelms' Wall Street
item.description: Tesla's long-awaited Cybercab update failed to dazzle investors.

item.title: We got more defensive last week as Wall Street raised the bar for AI stocks
item.description: We initiated positions in defensive stocks to balance our AI exposure amid higher oil prices and Treasury yields.

item.title: From Trump’s takeover threats to a ‘northern neighborhood,’ why the EU chief is going to Greenland
item.description: The visit comes as Trump renews his push for greater U.S. control of the self-governing Danish territory.
